targets.query:
from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mppt_0_daily_kwh" or r._field == "mppt_1_daily_kwh" or r._field == "mppt_2_daily_kwh" or r._field == "tasmota_0_daily_kwh" or r._field == "tasmota_1_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "mppt_0_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-0" else if r._field == "mppt_1_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-1" else if r._field == "mppt_2_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-2" else if r._field == "tasmota_0_daily_kwh" then "Tasmota-1" else "Tasmota-2"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_in_daily_kwh" or r._field == "battery_out_daily_kwh" or r._field == "consumption_daily_kwh" or r._field == "grid_in_daily_kwh" or r._field == "grid_out_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "battery_in_daily_kwh" then "Battery In" else if r._field == "battery_out_daily_kwh" then "Battery Out" else if r._field == "consumption_daily_kwh" then "Consumption" else if r._field == "grid_in_daily_kwh" then "Grid Import" else "Grid Export"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mppt_0_power" or r._field == "mppt_1_power" or r._field == "mppt_2_power" or r._field == "tasmota_0_power" or r._field == "tasmota_1_power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "mppt_0_power" then "MPPT-0" else if r._field == "mppt_1_power" then "MPPT-1" else if r._field == "mppt_2_power" then "MPPT-2" else if r._field == "tasmota_0_power" then "Tasmota-1" else "Tasmota-2"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

charging = from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "battery_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Charging (In)"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

discharging = from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "battery_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: -r._value}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Discharging (Out)"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

union(tables: [charging, discharging])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "solar_total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 * 1.0, _field: "Solar"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "battery_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value < 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: -r._value}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 * 1.0, _field: "Battery"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "grid_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 * 1.0, _field: "Grid"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mppt_0_daily_kwh" or r._field == "mppt_1_daily_kwh" or r._field == "mppt_2_daily_kwh" or r._field == "tasmota_0_daily_kwh" or r._field == "tasmota_1_daily_kwh")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "mppt_0_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-0" else if r._field == "mppt_1_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-1" else if r._field == "mppt_2_daily_kwh" then "MPPT-2" else if r._field == "tasmota_0_daily_kwh" then "Tasmota-1" else "Tasmota-2"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_in_daily_kwh" or r._field == "battery_out_daily_kwh")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "battery_in_daily_kwh" then "Battery In" else "Battery Out"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "pv_total_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Total Solar"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "consumption_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Consumption"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])

gridIn = from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "grid_in_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

gridOut = from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "grid_out_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inverter" and r._field == "grid_in_daily_kwh")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: gridOut._value - gridIn._value, _field: "Net Grid (+ = export)"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])
